data.name: Company Rising
data.detailed_description:
*Rise of the Company* is a Chinese-language company management simulation game centered on modern business expansion. Players will start with a startup, taking on projects, recruiting talent, upgrading offices, and expanding business within limited cash, staff, and office space. They will gradually progress through more complex business stages, including financing, IPOs, mergers and acquisitions, independent R&D, manufacturing, and marketing.

💼 From Solo Entrepreneurship to a Trillion-Dollar Business Empire

Start from scratch, take on projects, recruit employees, expand offices, develop products, build factories, invest and acquire, and ultimately ring the IPO bell.

💸 Cash Flow Crisis📉 Stock Price Plunge🤝 Investor Pressure📜 Failed Performance-Based Agreement

Can you retain control of your company?

🏢 Start from a Small Company

In *Rise of the Company*, you will play the role of a company founder, starting with a small team of a few people and gradually building your own business empire.

Every decision can impact the company's future:

✅ Expanding staff ✅ Upgrading offices ✅ Developing new products ✅ Entering new industries ✅ Attracting investment ✅ Pushing for an IPO

📋 Taking on projects to earn your first pot of gold

In the early stages of the game, the company primarily relies on taking on projects to generate revenue.

Projects offer:

🎯 Different types ⚡ Different difficulties 💰 Different returns ⚠️ Different risks 📅 Different deadlines

Establish a reasonable team, improve efficiency, and acquire more clients.

💵 Manage cash flow, not just profits

The reason a company goes bankrupt is often not because of losses, but because:

Lack of money.

Daily cash outflows:

👨‍💼 Employee salaries 🏢 Office rent 🏭 Factory expenses 🔬 R&D investment 📦 Inventory backlog 🏦 Loan repayments

When cash becomes negative:

🚨 Company enters a cash flow crisis ⏳ Continuous losses may lead to bankruptcy and liquidation

👥 Recruit employees and build an organizational structure

As you scale, you can build a complete enterprise system:

👨‍💼 Project managers 🏛️ Project directors 💰 Finance department 🧾 Legal department 📋 Human resources department 🖥️ Professional staff

A high-performing team will become the core driving force for company growth.

🌎 Multi-industry expansion, building a business empire

Enter multiple industries and develop your own business empire:

🤖 Artificial Intelligence

Build an AI platform and develop users, memberships, and API revenue.

🎮 Gaming & Entertainment

Develop your own games and generate long-term revenue.

📱 Consumer Electronics

Product development, technology accumulation, manufacturing, and marketing.

🚗 New Energy Vehicles

Develop automotive technology, design vehicle models, and enter the era of complete vehicle manufacturing.

Each industry has its own independent development path.

🏭 Build a Factory, Create a Complete Industrial Chain

Invest in building your own factory:

🏠 Daily Necessities Factory 🍔 Food & Beverage Factory 👕 Garment & Textile Factory 📱 Consumer Electronics Factory 🚘 Vehicle Manufacturing Factory

Management:

⚙️ Production Line 👷 Workers 📦 Warehouse 🔧 Equipment Maintenance 📈 Capacity Upgrade 🤖 Automated Production

Complete Business Loop:

🔬 R&D → 🏭 Production → 📦 Warehousing → 💲 Pricing → 🛒 Sales

A blockbuster product may sell out overnight, while outdated products may go unsold.

📈 Capital Markets and the Path to IPO

As your company grows and expands, you will enter the capital markets:

🤝 Introducing investors 🏦 Bank loans 🔄 Share buybacks 🏢 Mergers and acquisitions 📈 Investing in other companies 🔔 Applying for an IPO

📊 IPO is just the beginning

After listing:

📈 Real-time stock price fluctuations 💹 Continuous changes in market capitalization 📰 Market events impacting the market 💰 Investor confidence altering valuations

Stock price is influenced by:

✔️ Profitability ✔️ Corporate reputation ✔️ Financial health ✔️ Market expectations ✔️ Market events

These factors all contribute to the overall impact.

🏠 Founder's Wealth System

You are not only running a company, but also managing your own life.

Founders can own:

💵 Cash 📈 Stocks 🏠 Real estate 🚗 Luxury cars

Company market capitalization ≠ Personal wealth

How to transform corporate value into personal wealth is also a business art. 🌟 Reputation and Brand Influence

Corporate influence stems from:

🏆 Project Quality 📱 Product Sales 🤖 AI User Growth 🎮 Game Revenue 🚗 Car Sales 😊 Customer Satisfaction

A great company relies on more than just making money.

It also relies on brand influence.

🏆 Leaderboards & Achievement System

Challenge global players and vie for the business throne:

👑 Highest Market Value 🚀 Fastest IPO 👥 Largest Staff 📋 Most Completed Projects 💰 Richest Founder 🌎 Strongest Business Empire

Unlock 60+ Achievements:

🏅 From Zero to IPO 🏰 Trillion-Dollar Empire 💎 World's Richest Person 📈 Business Legend 👑 King of Business

✨ Game Features

✅ Modern Chinese Business Simulation 🏢 Complete growth experience from startup to IPO 🤖 Four major industries: AI, Gaming, Consumer Electronics, and New Energy Vehicles 👥 Employee Training and Organizational Structure System 💰 Realistic Cash Flow and Financial Management 🏭 Factory Production, Warehousing, and Marketing 📈 Stock Market, Financing, Mergers & Acquisitions, and Capital Gameplay 🚗 Founder Asset System 🏆 Leaderboards and Multi-Dimensional Achievement System

📢 A brief summary:

From a lone entrepreneur to a trillion-dollar empire.

In *Rise of the Company*, you're not just running a company, but embarking on an ultimate challenge involving cash flow, equity, capital, and business acumen.

(Inquiries, gameplay, guides)
